links.comparator_used: Conventional accuracy metrics on the benchmark, which the authors say miss behavioral volatility from quantization, distillation and sparse architectures
links.outcome: Detection of model compression and instability (quantized vs full-precision variants; Flip Rate across commercial API models in a longitudinal audit)
links.effect: 100% accuracy distinguishing full-precision from quantized variants across 11 local model families; distilled 'Nano' models had a 2.82% vs 1.58% Flip Rate compared with standard counterparts
links.quote: Validated on 11 local model families, our approach achieved 100% accuracy in distinguishing full-precision models from quantized variants.

design_hint: pre-deployment model stability auditing (logit fingerprint / flip rate monitoring)
